THE SOUND ENGINE

Sound
in motion.

Two wavetable oscillators move as one living body of sound. A resonant four-pole filter, two envelopes, and an LFO that breathes — all tuned to feel warm at any depth.

  • Two wavetable coresEight frames, continuously morphed
  • Twelve voicesReal polyphony, no voice stealing in a chord
  • Stereo by natureEvery voice finds its own place in the field
Shape the sound ↓

AB

Morph from a glassy sine to a torn, singing saw. Never a switch — always a journey.

DESIGN & BUILD

One billet.
No shortcuts.

ADSR ×2

Independent amplitude and filter contours.
